ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three horizontal three-phase lines, labeled A, B, C; below there are three identical impedance elements Z, forming a balanced delta load according to the connection relationship between the three-phase lines. On the right side there is a switch K, and after the switch are connected three capacitors C; the problem states that K is open, so the capacitor branch on the right side is isolated and does not participate in the current calculation. The direction of current i_B is marked on the B-phase line. Reasoning calculation: When K is open, it is only necessary to calculate the load current of the balanced delta formed by the three Z. Each delta branch bears the line voltage U_L = 300 V. The impedance magnitude is |Z| = sqrt(60^2 + 80^2) = 100 Ω, so the current of each delta branch is I_phase = U_L / |Z| = 300 / 100 = 3 A. The magnitude of the line current of a balanced delta load is sqrt(3) times the branch current, therefore I_B = sqrt(3) × 3 = 5.196 A, approximately 5.2 A.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the three Z elements as a balanced delta-connected load across the three phase lines, and observe that the open switch K isolates the capacitors. From the text, take U_L=300 V and Z=60+j80 ohm. Compute the delta branch current using the line voltage across each branch, then convert branch current to B-line current with the balanced-delta relation I_B=sqrt(3)U_L/|Z|.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三条水平三相线路，标为 A、B、C；下方有三个相同的阻抗元件 Z，按三相线之间的连接关系构成平衡三角形负载。右侧有开关 K，开关后接三只电容 C；题设为 K 断开，因此右侧电容支路被隔离，不参与电流计算。B 相线上标出了电流 i_B 的方向。

推理计算：K 断开时，只需计算三只 Z 组成的平衡三角形负载电流。每个三角形支路承受线电压 U_L = 300 V。阻抗大小为 |Z| = sqrt(60^2 + 80^2) = 100 Ω，所以每个三角形支路电流为 I_phase = U_L / |Z| = 300 / 100 = 3 A。平衡三角形负载的线电流大小为支路电流的 sqrt(3) 倍，因此 I_B = sqrt(3) × 3 = 5.196 A，约为 5.2 A。

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有三相线路 A、B、C，B 相线上标出了电流 i_B 的方向。下方有三个相同的阻抗元件，均标为 Z，构成三相平衡负载。右侧通过开关 K 接入一组三个电容 C；图中 K 处于断开位置，因此右侧电容支路与三相线路断开。

推理：按指定方法，K 断开时电容组不参与电路，只保留由三个相同 Z 构成的平衡三角形负载。将平衡三角形负载等效为星形负载，则每相星形阻抗为 Z_Y = Z/3。已知 Z = 60 + j80 Ω，所以 |Z| = sqrt(60^2 + 80^2) = 100 Ω，因此 |Z_Y| = 100/3 Ω。线电压 U_L = 300 V，等效星形每相电压为 U_phase = U_L/sqrt(3) = 300/sqrt(3) V。线电流等于星形相电流，所以 I_B = U_phase / |Z_Y| = (300/sqrt(3)) / (100/3) = 5.196 A，约为 5.2 A。
